criteria.title: Construct separate address spaces with explicit user/supervisor and write/execute policy.
criteria.task: Derive effective permissions along all page-table levels for the process window, kernel identity region, text, data and guard. In an intentionally flawed guest map a dedicated synthetic kernel sentinel page as user-writable; compare corrected permissions.
criteria.purpose: A user bit at an upper level alone neither grants every leaf nor proves safe supervisor mappings.

security.scope: Original teaching kernel and synthetic bounded helpers only; no external targets.
security.target: Learner-owned CMK kernel and original ring3 test programs; dedicated synthetic sentinel data.
security.environment: Disposable one-vCPU QEMU guest with ordinary build-directory disk image; isolated hosted address-model helper where specified.
security.attacker_capabilities: Original test program controls its user addresses, lengths, tokens and syscall arguments; no host access or credentials.
security.isolation: No network, shared host filesystem, device passthrough or privileged host changes. Use fresh disposable guest copies and synthetic data.
security.defect: Incorrect page permission or incomplete range/ownership validation violates isolation or authority confinement.
security.exposing_transition: Use a deliberately weakened sentinel-page mapping, or a bounded first-page-only validation model, then submit the exact invalid address/span/token described by the criterion.
security.exploitability_limits: Only the stated sentinel or model-side-effect violation is claimed. A fault, crash or sanitizer report does not prove arbitrary execution, privilege escalation or host escape.
security.success_condition: Flawed original target changes its synthetic sentinel or accepts the declared unauthorized model action; corrected target refuses while preserving sentinel/resources and peer progress.
security.repair: Validate effective page permissions, complete extents and process-local token ownership before publishing effects; preserve lifetime and failure contracts.
security.regression: Run valid accesses and exact invalid boundary cases against both flawed and repaired copies, checking full before/after state and peer progress.
security.residual_limits: Finite guest/model observations do not establish complete memory safety, physical CPU behavior or security of other systems.
